HOW IT WORKS
Best one-suit total wins. A=11, faces=10.
Trips = 30.5. Draw, then discard.
KNOCK instead of drawing — everyone gets one last turn, low hand loses a chip.
Knock and come up short? Two chips.
Hit 31 — everyone else pays instantly.
Out of chips = one free ride on the bus.
